user.title: Connect to Sunny Island
user.description: PowerManager only reads the device during setup.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Sunny Island
error.unsupported_device: This SMA device is not a supported Sunny Island

init.title: Polling settings
init.description: Choose how often PowerManager reads the Sunny Island. Power and forecast selectors are unit-filtered. Market prices must use an explicit /kWh or /MWh unit.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between read-only Sunny Island polls.
data_description.grid_power_entity: Instantaneous net grid exchange in W or kW. Positive means importing from the grid; negative means exporting.
data_description.pv_power_entity: Instantaneous AC power generated by the PV system in W or kW.
data_description.load_power_entity: Instantaneous total household consumption in W or kW, including every local consumer you want considered by policy simulation.
data_description.telemetry_max_age: Telemetry older than this is treated as stale and is excluded from policy evaluation.
data_description.price_entity: Current import price with an explicit currency/kWh or currency/MWh unit. Unitless prices are ignored.
data_description.remaining_pv_forecast_entity: Forecast energy still expected from PV during the planning period, in Wh, kWh, or MWh. Use a remaining forecast, not a lifetime energy meter.
data_description.remaining_load_forecast_entity: Forecast energy still expected to be consumed during the planning period, in Wh, kWh, or MWh. Use a remaining forecast, not a cumulative meter.

communication_failure.title: Sunny Island communication failure
communication_failure.description: PowerManager cannot read the Sunny Island. The integration remains monitor-only and retries with backoff.

possible_external_controller.title: Possible competing SMA controller detected
possible_external_controller.description: A non-Sunny-Island sender was observed on SMA Speedwire. Do not enable active control until ownership has been confirmed.
